scale_cues: Round light-blue dinner plate assumed ~26-27 cm diameter, viewed from overhead; item sizes judged relative to the plate (potato chunks ~4-5 cm, melon cubes ~2.5-3.5 cm, bacon strips ~12-15 cm cooked length).
assumptions: Plate diameter assumed ~26-27 cm; no cutlery or hand for scale
Green cubes identified as honeydew melon (could be cucumber, which would lower calories)
Bacon counted as about 3 cooked pork strips at ~9 g each
Potatoes assumed roasted with a small amount of oil; oil listed separately and potato kcal given without the oil
Single layer of food, no hidden items beneath
